label: Town of Rutland
header:
# Town of Rutland municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 20; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: Dan Alcorn is Town Moderator, term to March 2027
Town of Rutland, 2026 Warning printed in the FY2025 Town Report (Article 23, dated January 20, 2026): the warning elects a Moderator for a one-year term
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Rutland Town elects its clerk to a three-year term

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: Kari Clark is Town Clerk, her three-year term running to March 2029 (the seat stood and was won at the March 2026 meeting)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kari Clark as Rutland Town's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer; Rutland Town elects its treasurer to a three-year term

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: Kari Clark is Town Treasurer, her three-year term running to March 2029
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kari Clark as Rutland Town's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Rutland Town's five selectboard members under the directory form 'Mary Ashcroft-Billings' (Chair), Joseph Denardo, Matthew Getty, Kurt Hathaway, and Sharon Russell

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: the board is Mary Ashcroft (Chair; won the three-year seat, term to March 2029), Kurt Hathaway (won the two-year seat, to March 2028), Joseph Denardo (to March 2028), Matthew Getty (to March 2027), and Sharon Russell (to March 2027). The town's own roster and report signatures read 'Mary Ashcroft', which governs over the directory's fuller form

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: the listers are Marcia Chioffi (won the three-year seat, term to March 2029), Cathy Kapitanski (to March 2028), and Marie Fabian (to March 2027)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a first constable

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: Michael Delehanty is First Constable, having won the two-year seat (term to March 2028)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns may elect a second constable

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: John Paul Faignant is Second Constable, term to March 2027; the seat did not stand in 2026

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes for a one-year term unless the town votes a longer term
Town of Rutland, Collector of Delinquent Taxes page (rutlandtown.com): Donald 'Don' Chioffi holds the office -- 'As an elected official answerable to the voters of our town'

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: Donald Chioffi's term as Collector of Delinquent Taxes runs to March 2027

Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: the cemetery commissioners are Dakota Harvey (term to March 2028), Byron 'BJ' Hathaway (to March 2027), and Kurt Hathaway (to March 2027)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a grand juror for a one-year term
Town of Rutland, 'Elected and Appointed Officials & Term Information' page (rutlandtown.com), the town's current roster with term expirations: Jennifer Roberts is Grand Juror, term to March 2027
Town of Rutland, 2026 Warning printed in the FY2025 Town Report (Article 23, dated January 20, 2026): the warning elects a Grand Juror for a one-year term

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Rutland Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Rutland Town justices of the peace: Leigh Adams, Howard Burgess, Glen Giles, Martin Wasserman, Marc D. Brierre, William T. Matteson, Christopher K. Howland, James B. Hall, Marcia Chioffi, Donald Chioffi, Frederick Nicholson, and Joseph Bertelloni. Christopher Howland is also Rutland Town's State Representative (Rutland-4); his justice of the peace membership reuses his state-tier person record
